name: Girafficus
source:
Girafficus is a peculiar game. Will you survive this stranger's presence, or will you be swept into your untimely demise? Who knows! Maybe you'll have a great time and become friends! This bizarre game can only be described as a strange mix of comedy and horror... and maybe... friendship?

[from [url=https://thesparklyvoidlord.itch.io/girafficus]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Girafficus》是一款奇特的游戏。面对这位陌生人，你能平安无事，还是会被卷入一场过早到来的死亡？谁知道呢！也许你会玩得很开心，还能交上朋友！这款离奇游戏，只能说是喜剧与恐怖的古怪混合体……或许……还有友情？

[摘自[url=https://thesparklyvoidlord.itch.io/girafficus]itch.io[/url]]
